name: Liu Fang-p’ing
bio: Liu Fang-p’ing is dated by Giles to the 8th or 9th century AD. His poem here is a lonely woman’s spring.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: The Spinster
poems.author: Liu Fang-p’ing
